features: Visual Clarity in Reversed Payments: Improved visual distinction between original (cancelled) payments and reversal (compensation) operations in the payment list, preventing ambiguities.
Quick Filters on Statistic Cards: Financial summary cards in the payments tab are now clickable, allowing instant filtering of the table by withholding taxes or reversed operations.
Optimized Registration Flow: After registering a new payment, the success screen now correctly redirects to the list of made payments instead of invoices, streamlining the workflow.

Global UI Alignment: The interactive design system for statistic cards has been uniformly extended to the Invoices and Installment Collections lists, introducing quick filters and consistent visual transitions across the entire system.
UI/UX Improvements in Accounting Documents: Fixed text overflow issues on long notes and IBANs in the detail page, integrating responsive display of the Audit Trail for legal approvals.
Native PDF Document Infrastructure: Added the capability to generate and download the Supplier Payment Slip (Distinta) in PDF format, based on native templates.
PSR-4 Exceptions Refactoring: Completed the architectural refactoring of system exceptions to fully comply with PSR-4 standards.
Installment Collections Detail View: Added a read-only view to analytically explore the composition of an installment collection, highlighting if paid via direct payment or credit compensation.
Table Tooltips Optimization: Replaced native text tooltips with interactive HoverCards (Shadcn) for immediate and rich reading of amounts details in Invoices and Payments tables.

Schedules and Allotment Prints (PDF): Released the official printing suite for installment plans (Schedule / Installment Prospectus) and for the chart of accounts (Estimate Bill and Expense Allotment). Layouts include legal reference headers and printer-friendly design.

Multiple PDF Aggregation Options: The administrator can now dynamically choose whether to export the Installment Prospectus grouped 'By Condominium Owner', 'By Property Unit', or combining both views into a single multi-page PDF document.

PDF Integrity and Balancing Tests: Integrated a comprehensive test suite dedicated to print controllers ensuring perfect cross-checks: every amount shown on PDFs must strictly match the totals in the database, preventing any printing misalignments.

Signed URL Security Fix: Replaced the email address with the user ID in encrypted links for invitations and password resets, permanently resolving a 403 error caused by automatic decoding of the '@' character by browsers and email clients.
Link Expiration UX Improvement: Extended the validity of links for accepting invitations and setting passwords from 60 minutes to 3 days, giving users more time to complete registration.
Chart of Accounts UI Optimization: Grouped the print buttons (Estimate Bill and Expense Allotment) into a single 'Prints' dropdown menu to save space and maintain a clean layout on smaller screens.
Document UI Alignment: Standardized the design of document upload and edit pages (DocumentiNew, DocumentiEdit) to the system standard (AppLayout, PageHeaderGuide).

Document Table Optimization: Fixed a RangeError on date formatting in production, added missing visibility badge translations (Public/Private), and renamed the 'Date' column to 'Uploaded on' for better clarity.

Existing Invoice Attachments Display Fix: Corrected an issue in the Invoice Details view (FatturaShow) that prevented the correct display of attached document names and sizes due to misaligned properties with the data model.

New Invoice Attachments Upload Fix: Resolved a critical bug during new invoice registration that caused the attached document to be lost upon form submission due to a JSON conversion destroying the File object.

Operating Inbox Payment Auto-population Fix: Resolved an issue where clicking 'Resolve' on a payment task from the Operating Inbox did not pre-populate the payment form. The system now automatically infers the supplier from the passed invoice.
